prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent game skill icon, square, designed to remain crisp and immediately legible at 48x48 pixels in a compact action-game HUD. Primary request: Resonance Node for Gu Pin, an original salvage-world signal technician. Single bold focal object: a small sturdy three-legged industrial capacitor node, aged ivory ceramic cylinder with a broad peacock-teal mineral core window, warm copper top cap and three dark umber spread tripod feet. Two clean short concentric teal signal arcs hover immediately above the node, simple readable bands indicating resonance. No many fine rings, no particles. Premium hand-painted stylized industrial fantasy illustration, strong unmistakable tripod silhouette, chunky readable planes, high local contrast, controlled highlights, slight three-quarter perspective, original crafted machinery. Palette: aged ivory #D2D1BB, peacock teal #3E8D8D with restrained brighter cyan core, dark umber #4B443D, warm copper. Detail only on broad material planes: chipped ceramic and copper edge highlights, no tiny knobs or busy wiring. Centered, full node and signal arcs contained inside generous 12% safe margins. Transparent alpha background, completely isolated. No environment, ground, background color, ground shadow, border, frame, circular UI badge, text, numbers, letters, logos or watermark. No character, no magical runes, no ornate filigree, no recognizable existing game symbol. Do not add a square panel behind the icon.
